name: Jenner JR7-D
sculpt: Catalyst Game Labs 2021 Inner Sphere Striker Lance 35729, base 63

reference.copyright: External reference only; do not commit downloaded photos
reference.status: Reference-informed physical part reconstruction. Existing low-confidence photo-mask IoU is NOT yet improved; do not replace production Jenner.

signature_features: rounded low-projecting cockpit disk with segmented glazing
distinctive stepped shoulder fairings with outboard pods

assembly_guide.cut_policy: transfer-owner-only: preserve occupied voxels, forbid bridge repairs
assembly_guide.camera_and_stance: experimental; no claim of calibrated matching
assembly_guide.structural_rule: backed 2x2 face patch and oriented connection normal
assembly_guide.editorial_note: All parts unique to this Jenner, not shared generic mech geometry
assembly_guide.angular_joints: Each oblique interface requires measured outward face normal and backed 2x2 load-bearing contact
assembly_guide.symmetry: Mirrored world-space cuts with independently verified left/right contacts
assembly_guide.smooth_contours: 32-point cockpit and pod contours, additional 16-point hard-surface armor contours
assembly_guide.no_invented_bloat: Rigid subassemblies transfer occupied cells from a unique source owner without adding hidden filler voxels
assembly_guide.full_joint_audit: All 29 parent-child attachments checked for backed face patch and measured angular error

shape_fit_notes.reference: Catalyst 2021 CAT35729 Jenner; unpainted retailer photos and same-sculpt painted gallery
shape_fit_notes.head: Wider, shallower saucer, three forward window facets, two dorsal panes
shape_fit_notes.shoulders: Outer shoulder armor broadened and angled; pods compressed toward their outboard caps without exceeding previous outer silhouette
shape_fit_notes.torso: Tapered hip saddle; no additional bulk or new generic repair pieces
shape_fit_notes.legs: Forward knee profile; physical shallow grooves between three claw tips
shape_fit_notes.limitations: Coarse hand-traced silhouette metric is not calibrated photo accuracy
shape_fit_notes.pod_alignment: Port bores, barrel supports and muzzle transforms mapped together, no duplicate arms

reference_fit_policy: Fit camera/pose once to v8 control; freeze camera, lens and pose across all v10/v11 candidates. Missing view is unscored.

multi_reference.frozen_camera_and_pose: v11 control; same per-photo camera, crop and leg posture used across candidates
multi_reference.held_out_oblique_side: Poor 0.114 crop camera-registration residual; upper-body only diagnostic, never used to justify improvement
passes: physically separated three forward glazing panels
slope the upper shoulder armor 0.02 model units
taper both three-toe feet without moving attachment pivots
multi_reference.limitations: Preview-scale image annotations have ±8–15 px uncertainty. No real lens calibration. Quantitative scores provisional.

reference_review.old_issue: torso continuous slab with too little rear lower-body taper; legs thin Z-struts and overly squared claws
trial_changes: Reduce only posterior waist and chest depth; preserve shoulder/head physical contacts
Extend individual toe tips, continue subtractive toe gaps to their new ends
Preserve all hip, knee, ankle pivots and independent rig ownership
Do NOT broaden upper thigh: detected disconnection of its knee-armor ownership after oblique segmentation; revert that change
reference_review.pose_caveat: Standing neutral source projection is not calibrated to actual miniature's bent and staggered leg pose. Do not interpret neutral front similarity as proof.
reference_review.acceptance: Do not promote without per-part 2x2 contact, multi-view camera+pose frozen reference metrics, and actual engine rig test
